title: Bulk α-quartz optimization and convergence
action: Perform convergence tests for bulk α-quartz using the chosen DFT code with LSDA to determine plane-wave cutoff and k-point grid; optimize lattice parameters and internal coordinates. This sets the computational parameters for all subsequent surface calculations.
description: Bulk convergence and structural optimization. The evidence (bulk_results.json) may store the final lattice parameters and convergence parameters; not directly scored.

title: Slab construction and relaxation
action: Build stoichiometric (001) and (100) α-quartz slabs with vacuum spacing of approximately 15 Å and surface area per side of ~100 Å². Relax each slab. Compute the total energy and the valence band maximum (E_VBM) for each slab.
description: Surface total energies and valence band maxima for the relaxed slabs, required as reference in the defect formation energy formula.

title: O₂ molecule reference calculation
action: Compute the total energy of an isolated O₂ molecule in the triplet state using the same DFT code and LSDA functional to obtain the oxygen chemical potential μ_O₂.
description: Single float value (eV): the total energy of O₂, serving as the oxygen chemical potential.

title: Defect formation energies and magnetic classification
action: For each of 6 oxygen vacancy sites (site1, site2, subsurface on (001); bridge, metastable ring, ring2III-O on (100)) in charge states 0, 1+, 2+, create the vacancy, relax the geometry, and compute the total energy at the lowest magnetic state by comparing constrained-magnetization calculations at 0, 1, and 2 μB. Classify the geometry (Si–Si dimer, puckered configuration, 2III-O) and mark as LEMS if the ground state is magnetic. Compute the formation energy using E_form = E_defect - E_slab + 0.5*μ_O₂ + q*E_VBM. Report all 18 entries.
description: Formation energies (eV) and magnetic ground-state properties for 18 oxygen vacancy configurations on (001) and (100) surfaces.
output_schema: surface (str), site (str), charge (int), geometry_type (str), E_form (float, eV), magnetic_moment_ground_state (float, µB), is_LEMS (bool)
